values.help:
Which sound system plays audio.

- Auto: PipeWire if running, otherwise PulseAudio, otherwise ALSA.
- PipeWire / PulseAudio: through the sound server (passthrough via the HDMI sink's formats).
- ALSA: direct to the device; most reliable for TrueHD and DTS-HD MA.
- JACK: PCM only (up to 7.1); passthrough is not available.

What Icefin sends over HDMI when a track starts while the receiver or TV reports it isn't ready (standby, off or unplugged). Linux doesn't mark a bitstream as compressed audio then, so a receiver may stay silent or play noise.

- Switch When It Wakes: PCM at first; once the receiver has been ready for 4 seconds (it may still be starting up), the bitstream.
- Always PCM: PCM for the whole track.
- Keep Bitstream: the bitstream the receiver took last time, straight away. For receivers that report standby wrongly but still decode.
Leave on. Turn off only if the app crashes or shows a black window at start with your graphics driver. Takes effect after a restart.

How the app draws its window. Auto picks the best that works here. Vulkan (experimental) draws the interface and video together on Vulkan, with zero-copy hardware decoding and HDR output on HDR displays. OpenGL is the fallback for systems without working Vulkan. Takes effect after a restart.

With the Vulkan renderer on an HDR display, the window is sent in HDR: HDR video plays in HDR, and the interface stays at your desktop's SDR brightness. Off sends SDR and tone-maps HDR video. Turning HDR on or off in your display settings applies after a restart. Takes effect after a restart.
On Nintendo controllers, the button marked A confirms and B goes back, as printed. Other controllers are unchanged.
The look of the app. Off keeps the stock look. Your choice is saved for your user on the server, so it follows you to other Icefin devices.
Play the theme's interface sounds. They are always silent while a movie's audio goes straight to your receiver (passthrough).
Play the theme's startup jingle when Icefin opens, and its short jingles where the theme has them (opening a channel, for example). Silent while anything plays.
Play the theme's background music on its screens. It fades out while a video or music plays, and never plays while audio goes straight to your receiver (passthrough).
How loud the theme's jingles and background music are, next to its interface sounds.

Keep the theme, colour scheme and preset the same on every Icefin device signed in to this account: a change here appears on the others, and theirs here. Off, this device keeps its own theme, so several devices on one account can use different themes at the same time.

How video is decoded. Auto is right for almost everyone.

- Auto: the GPU decodes what it safely can; everything else is decoded in software.
- VA-API: AMD and Intel GPUs.
- NVDEC: NVIDIA GPUs.
- Vulkan: Vulkan Video, on recent drivers.
- Copy: GPU decoding with a copy back to memory; slower, but works around driver bugs.
- Off: software decoding only. Use this if video is glitchy.
Ask the server to convert only what this machine can't play, based on the hardware test in Client Settings -> Hardware. The force-transcode switches still apply on top.

If set, the server always converts Dolby Vision profile 5 video before it plays. The default is off: the Vulkan renderer shows Dolby Vision itself, and where this renderer can't, Icefin asks at play time (play anyway, or ask the server for an HDR10 or SDR version).

How big the controls over a playing video are: the seek bar, buttons, title, menus and skip buttons. Subtitles are not changed.

- Auto: sized by the screen's height, so they look the same on a 1080p and a 4K screen (twice the size on 4K), and larger again in Couch Mode.
- A percentage: that much of the Auto size.
For watching from across the room: larger player controls, thicker focus outlines, and controller hints shown at all times. Turn it on here, or let Detect Couch Displays turn it on for a TV.

Turn Couch Mode on by itself on a TV-sized display (about 40 inches and up, from the size the display reports) and when running in Steam's Big Picture or Gamescope. Untick it to leave Couch Mode to the switch above.
